legion_specific_findings.title: ERC777 bidToken cross-function reentrancy: invest() -> tokensToSend hook -> refund()

steps: Step 1: Attacker invests P tokens normally (investedCapital=P)
Step 2: During sale, attacker calls invest(amount=1, newSignature)
Step 3: invest() updates state: totalCapitalInvested+=1, investedCapital=P+1, sig marked used
Step 4: safeTransferFrom(bidToken, attacker, contract, 1) triggers ERC777 tokensToSend hook on attacker
Step 5: In tokensToSend hook, attacker calls refund()
Step 6: refund() reads investedCapital=P+1 (already inflated), sets to 0, hasRefunded=true, transfers P+1 to attacker
Step 7: Hook returns, ERC777 transfer of 1 token completes
exploit_path.net_effect: Attacker paid P+1 total, received P+1 via refund. Net financial gain = 0. BUT: 1 token permanently locked in contract, totalCapitalInvested miscounts, hasRefunded=true blocks attacker from claiming token allocation
exploit_path.timing_window: Both invest() and refund() are callable during active sale period (timestamp < endTime < refundEndTime)

legion_specific_findings.root_cause: invest() updates state (investedCapital, totalCapitalInvested) BEFORE the safeTransferFrom call. ERC777 tokensToSend hook fires before transfer completes, allowing re-entrant call to refund() which reads the already-incremented investedCapital.
impact: ACCOUNTING CORRUPTION: 1 token per attack locked in contract, totalCapitalInvested underreports actual balance
REFUND BYPASS: attacker can execute invest+refund atomically, circumventing intended sequential workflow
POSITION CORRUPTION: hasRefunded=true means attacker position cannot claim tokens even though they participated
legion_specific_findings.mitigation: Add nonReentrant modifier to invest() and/or refund(). Alternatively, move safeTransferFrom to before state updates (strict CEI), though this is complex with the existing signature-before-transfer pattern.

legion_specific_findings.title: ERC777 askToken in claimTokenAllocation(): tokensReceived fires after hasSettled=true - SAFE

steps: Step 1: claimTokenAllocation() sets position.hasSettled = true BEFORE any transfers
Step 2: _createVesting() deploys vesting contract (factory is trusted)
Step 3: safeTransfer(askToken, vestingAddress, ...) - tokensReceived on vesting contract (Legion-controlled)
Step 4: safeTransfer(askToken, msg.sender, ...) - tokensReceived on attacker
Step 5: Attacker tries to re-enter claimTokenAllocation()
Step 6: _verifyCanClaimTokenAllocation checks hasSettled=true -> REVERT

legion_specific_findings.title: ERC777 bidToken in refund(): CEI compliant, hasRefunded flag blocks re-entry - SAFE

steps: Step 1: refund() clears investedCapital=0 and sets hasRefunded=true BEFORE transfer
Step 2: safeTransfer fires tokensReceived on attacker
Step 3: Attacker calls refund() again
Step 4: _verifyHasNotRefunded -> REVERT (hasRefunded=true)
exploit_path.net_effect: SAFE: Correct CEI order protects against double-refund

legion_specific_findings.title: ERC777 bidToken invest() state-before-transfer: enables atomically embedded invest+refund bypassing sequential intent

detailed_exploit.prerequisite: ERC777 bidToken; attacker implements tokensToSend hook
steps: Step 1: Attacker accumulates investedCapital=P via normal investments
Step 2: During sale, attacker calls invest(1, fresh_sig)
Step 3: invest(): totalCapitalInvested+=1, investedCapital=P+1, sig consumed
Step 4: invest() calls safeTransferFrom(bidToken, attacker, contract, 1)
Step 5: ERC777 tokensToSend fires on attacker with amount=1
Step 6: Attacker tokensToSend calls refund()
Step 7: refund() reads investedCapital=P+1, transfers P+1 tokens to attacker, sets hasRefunded=true, investedCapital=0, totalCapitalInvested-=P+1
Step 8: ERC777 transfer of 1 token from attacker to contract completes (independent of hook)
Final state: contract received 1 extra token, totalCapitalInvested = T+1-(P+1) = T-P (correct mathematically but 1 token unaccounted in contract balance)
detailed_exploit.timing_window: invest() callable when timestamp < endTime. refund() callable when timestamp < refundEndTime (= endTime + refundPeriod). Both callable during [startTime, endTime).
detailed_exploit.scalability: Multiple investors can execute this attack, causing cumulative accounting drift

legion_specific_findings.root_cause: invest() increments investedCapital BEFORE safeTransferFrom. ERC777 tokensToSend hook provides execution before transfer completes. nonReentrant guard absent.
impact: Accounting discrepancy: N tokens locked per N attacks
totalCapitalInvested drifts below actual contract balance
publishSaleResults (FixedPriceSale/AbstractSale) and related reporting based on stale totalCapitalInvested
hasRefunded flag set inconsistently relative to actual token ownership
Protocol invariant violated: sum(investedCapital[i]) != contract.balanceOf(bidToken) after attack
mitigation: Primary: Add nonReentrant modifier to invest() - prevents cross-function re-entrancy
Secondary: Add nonReentrant to refund() as well for complete protection
Alternative: Move safeTransferFrom BEFORE state updates in invest() (strict CEI). Warning: complex since _verifyValidPosition depends on updated position state.
Defense-in-depth: Add invariant check: require(contract.balance >= totalCapitalInvested) in critical functions
